@notes.Pictures: Ribbon group name (Insert tab) and the file picker filter name.
@notes.Go to: Button: scroll to this picture in the document. Short.

@notes.Hat: Equation accent: a hat over a letter.
@notes.Bar: Equation accent: a bar over a letter.
@notes.Any unit: Equation template: an empty box for any unit.

@notes.second: SI unit name (the time unit, not the ordinal).
@notes.mole: SI unit of amount of substance.
@notes.percent: The percent sign as a unit.

@notes.More: Section title in the Help side list for pages not listed in a section.
@notes.Help home: The first page of the Help manual.

@notes.same as Word: Screen reader name of the "Word" badge next to a shortcut.
